value.rationale: This is a structural classification of the most direct cyclic-width continuation of the source's coefficient-sensitive example, not an arbitrary finite computation. It isolates the exact parity mechanism behind characteristic-two sensitivity and supplies an all-coefficient-ring formula, providing a reusable test family for questions about base change and universal-coefficient behavior in path homology. The later arbitrary-prime existence construction does not remove the value of an explicit natural-family classification.
